status: six source-validated semantic schedules, one real-checkpoint prepared response and reference-quality control, and independent float32 held-out rank cuts; no protected composition admitted

comparison.execution_shape: 39 input tokens plus 32 selected tokens, 70 executed decoder rows
comparison.protocol_projection: Existing prepared stage shape with one optimistically u16 input, u16 output and u16 offline correction per remote stage row, with zero frame/control overhead; not a lower bound for new cryptographic protocols or a measured response on another model.
comparison.opening_projection: Two independent four-byte hidden-state source openings per layer row; excludes arithmetic, keys, rescaling, token selection and full wire. These bytes alone cannot establish a safe protocol.
comparison.remote_fraction_scope: Only counted remote transformer-body linear MACs versus the client output head; excludes attention, norms, source transfer, GPU and client setup.

smollm_prepared_candidate_control.experiment: W8A8 baseline MaskedLinearCpu, two distinct co-located role child processes, one warmup and one measured 39+32 response, request-sized inventory
smollm_prepared_candidate_control.one_warmup_client_bundle_cache: newly initialized isolated client cache; not an end-to-end cold model-distribution cohort

reference_quality.scope: local compiled clear W8A8 prefill next-token logits versus same-token frozen float32 reference; not generation quality

smollm_frozen_output_rank_oracle.cohorts: 20 public calibration, six separate tuning prompts left unused, 12 held-out prompts, 12 disjoint confirmation prompts; input-token counts range 7-35, not the 39-token cost cohort
smollm_frozen_output_rank_oracle.precision: frozen float32 pretrained checkpoint; no fine-tuning or distillation
smollm_frozen_output_rank_oracle.decision: No candidate preserves held-out prefill and decode decisions at the whole-decoder cut. Sparse three-layer cuts retain most decisions but cannot remove other remote stages; they do not qualify as a protected whole-decoder topology.

limitations: Pinned SmolLM checkpoint import and one matched-token prepared SDK response do complete; the separate prefill reference-quality diagnostic is narrow numeric parity, not task quality, same-token W8A8 decode parity or independent-provider privacy evidence.

The numeric oracle evaluates the complete original MLP before projecting its output. Its rank traffic projection omits attention, remaining MLPs, correlations, source loading, feedback and complete wire.

SmolLM and Qwen each returned 39+32 tokens, but their texts, source bodies and model utility differ. Their covered-body counts are not a cohort-safe quality/performance ranking. A Qwen-specific tenfold byte target remains only an architectural aspiration for other pretrained models.
The 256-width per-layer token table in Gemma 4 is not a 256-width residual-stream or nonlinear interface; its compiled remote plan retains a wider hidden stream.
reproduction: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=4 uv run --no-sync python scripts/probe_pretrained_bottleneck.py
